name: Cutover Runbook - Gate Locked
description: What someone who has the link but not the passphrase sees, which is the state this page spends most of its life in. Worth capturing rather than assuming, because the page names where the domain's records live and what has not been built yet, and a gate that fails open leaks that to anyone the link is forwarded to. The gate is hand-rolled here, as it is on the status page and the supporter-recognition deck: a raw public/ file is copied verbatim into dist/ and no Astro component ever renders it, so it cannot inherit the site's PreviewGate. Its sessionStorage key is its own, so unlocking the status page does not unlock this one — each artifact is shared, and revoked, on its own terms.
